content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices, especially in early periods of the 30-day window.
- Forecasts tend to be too smooth; fail to capture sharp spikes or sudden drops in true outcomes.
- Overshoots occur after large spikes in true values, suggesting model overreacts to recent volatility.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias — overcorrects after sharp moves, underestimating sustained trends.
- Forecasts lag behind true values by 1–3 days, particularly in the first 5–7 days of the forecast horizon.
- Model overestimates mid-to-late period prices when true values show downward correction or consolidation.
- High volatility in true outcomes is not reflected in forecast variance — model underweights noise.
